title: isolatedWorktree delegations refuse a dirty tree with untracked files, so a frozen review input cannot go to an isolated child without restaging
outcome: Reported by Engram::Opus (mailbox #237, 2026-09-25 22:59-23:02 UTC, parent session-7284): spawning Kimi as explorer with writePolicy isolatedWorktree, cwd = a worktree holding a new untracked file, returned 400 'isolatedWorktree delegation cannot materialize untracked files yet; stage, stash, or remove untracked file(s): docs/features/turn-gate-assessment.md'. Staging changes the review freeze, so Engram had to cancel an already-running Claude reviewer (delegation-666c6606), stage the files with unchanged content and re-freeze before Kimi could spawn (delegation-6efd570a). Agents that cannot run readOnly (Kimi, OpenCode; see tm-fy7m) can only use isolatedWorktree, so any review input with a new file is blocked for them. Wanted: materialize untracked files into the isolated snapshot (the /review-changes skill already names this limitation: 'isolated delegation worktree snapshots omit untracked files'), or otherwise let the child read the frozen input without mutating the parent's index.
